Package org.uma.evolver.meta.llm

Record Class LlmSettings

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
org.uma.evolver.meta.llm.LlmSettings
Record Components:
provider - ollama or openai
baseUrl - the address of the server (for openai, with the version, e.g. /v1)
model - the name of the model
apiKeyEnv - the environment variable with the key, or null
temperature - the sampling temperature
timeoutSeconds - the time to wait for an answer
options - more fields of the request
public record LlmSettings(String provider, String baseUrl, String model, String apiKeyEnv, double temperature, int timeoutSeconds, Map<String,Object> options) extends Record
Which language model to use, read from a YAML file: 

 provider: ollama              # or openai, for any server of the OpenAI chat API
 baseUrl: http://localhost:11434
 model: qwen3.5:35b-mlx
 apiKeyEnv: OPENAI_API_KEY     # the environment variable with the key, if the server needs one
 temperature: 0.7
 timeoutSeconds: 120
 options:                      # more fields of the request, as they are
   think: false

The key itself is never written in the file: apiKeyEnv names the environment variable that holds it.
